snippet.title: Manipulate TIME ITSELF in this indie PVP card battler - Chrono Cards
snippet.description:
PLAY CHRONO CARDS NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4402530?utm_campaign=demo&utm_source=yttrailer

Unlock a whole new dimension of competitive card gaming in Chrono Cards, an indie PVP card game by Weird Mage. Craft the ultimate deck, then carefully position your cards on the Timeline to triumph over your opponent. Warp time itself to launch the board into a Past or Future where you have the advantage.

Demo is AVAILABLE NOW! Invite your friends and play for free to learn who is the greatest time traveler of all. Full game releases November 16, so be sure to wishlist so you don't miss it!

Participate in our Community Tournament for your chance to help design a card that will make it into the full release! Tournament takes place October 24-25. Sign-ups available through our Discord server, where you can also leave feedback, find other players, and talk directly to the devs (we read everything and respond quick!): https://discord.gg/cNdPwb9wDe
